paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 31:9, [where he] said in the name of R' Yitzchak bar Ze'ira.[^1][^2]

notes.text: 31:9 is the conventional expansion of Vayikra Rabbah פל״א-ט; no named edition or modern numbering check was supplied.

The bracketed subject comes from the heading Hoshaya son of Shmelai of Caesarea. Both heading titles and body Yitzchak’s title stay R'; Ze'ira gains none. Hoshaya reports Yitzchak, not the reverse, without an independently bound identity.
